scope: Independent read-only design review; no runtime, debugger, simulator, account, storage, or private receipt action.

sourceFindings.existingSafeSink: No existing safe event is wired to ProfileStoragePreparationGate. The development bootstrap diagnostic bridge is used later by ContentPreparationGate/applicationBootstrap.
sourceFindings.gateProjection: ProfileStoragePreparationGate presents a distinct local sign-out message only for LocalLogoutControlError; otherwise it uses describeOperationalFailure, normally yielding LOCAL_OPERATION_FAILED. It separately retains allowlisted encryptedStorageFailureCode values when available.
sourceFindings.operationOrder: createNativeLocalLogoutControl and logoutControl.read precede prepareProfileStorage, which precedes inspectPreparedProfileState.
sourceFindings.mutationRisk: prepareProfileStorage can invoke encrypted-storage bootstrap that creates keys/manifests, opens or migrates storage, and inspects the registry. Repeating the ordinary gate is not a read-only action.

assessment.method: A breakpoint at the exact loaded catch entry is the smallest no-code-change way to observe the current error. Inspect only known class names, allowlisted own error codes, and allowlisted source-relative module filenames; resume immediately and detach.
assessment.privacy: Never inspect or emit message, raw stack, arbitrary object properties/getters, state, storage, identifiers, secrets, or native values. Keep debugger protocol output private and publish only a safe category/stage receipt.
assessment.priorDecisionConflict: This one ordinary reload repeats the gate despite not using the manual Retry button. Earlier Q13-RELEASE-STORAGE-DIAGNOSIS.md warns against diagnostic retry because a successful logout read proceeds into storage preparation. Treat the plan as a one-shot exception only after the corrected entry topology and with the conditions below.
assessment.noCausalClaim: The breakpoint result identifies one observed preparation failure only; it does not establish the underlying Keychain/MMKV cause or Q13 acceptance.

conditions: Bind the breakpoint to the unique active private-source ProfileStoragePreparationGate catch before the single ordinary reload.
If the category is not allowlisted or the breakpoint/module identity is uncertain, resume and stop without a second attempt.
If startup reaches ready, compare the selected account with its recorded baseline before any session/profile/UI mutation.
If startup remains unavailable, capture only the safe error category and stop; do not repeat snapshots, manually retry, bootstrap, clear, or bypass storage.
